prompt:

Asset: Badge back artwork

Composition: 2:3 aspect ratio.

Create one flat portrait-format reverse of the approved KORVEX employee card with the same proportions, white/charcoal/burgundy palette and typography. Exact text: "KORVEX" only. No decorative watermarks; the official contest watermark will be added during final editing.

Reference handling: Use the supplied images in the listed order and for their specified roles. Preserve selected designs; do not invent a new identity or silently replace a missing dependency.

Input images in order: badge-02.
